target.title: feat(sessions): create concise titles for saved sessions
target.body:
Closes #77165
Related #89705

## What Problem This Solves

Users with many saved sessions only had manual names, first-message fallbacks, or session-id fallbacks, so session history was hard to scan and search.

This PR adds an opt-in path that stores a durable `autoTitle` once enough direct user turns exist, while keeping manual labels/display names/origin labels/subjects higher priority.

The intended result is that enabled sessions can show and search concise stored titles in the gateway and Control UI, without changing default behavior or requiring a migration/backfill.

Out of scope: manual rename UI, migration/backfill for existing sessions, default-enabling generated titles, provider/channel/plugin capability changes, agent-facing `sessions_list` behavior, ConfigIO typing, generic session-store merge policy, and test-project routing.

## Why This Change Was Made

The feature is implemented as a default-off `sessionTitle` config surface plus additive `autoTitle` session metadata. The privacy/cost boundary is explicit: title generation is default-off; when enabled, the background title task reads only direct user text from the transcript head, skips heartbeat, internal-system, tool-mediated, and media-only/textless records, caps each message and the total model input, and writes only if the persisted `sessionId` still matches.

The title lifecycle is kept at the session metadata source of truth: `autoTitle` is created once after a successful reply, persisted without refreshing `updatedAt`, cleared on reset/new/rollover, and projected to gateway and Control UI consumers. This avoids recomputing titles in display fallbacks and avoids making an older session look newly active when a delayed title write lands later.

Manual title sources remain authoritative, and the feature stays opt-in/default-off. Title generation runs only after reply delivery; failures log or no-op and do not block, retry, or change the user reply. The remaining product/privacy/auth-profile routing decisions are maintainer-owned because enabled sessions send bounded transcript excerpts to the selected title model.

## User Impact

When `sessionTitle.enabled` is true, users with many saved sessions can identify conversations by concise stored titles instead of first-message snippets or ids.

Default-off behavior is unchanged. Existing manual names still win over generated titles, reset/rollover clears generated metadata without removing manual names, and late background title writes do not reorder sessions by refreshing activity timestamps.

## Evidence

- **Fix classification:** Root-cause feature completion for opt-in model-created session titles.
- **Maintainer-ready confidence:** High for the scoped code update after focused validation and local real gateway proof; maintainer product/privacy/auth acceptance remains maintainer-owned before merge.
- **Root cause:** Saved sessions had no durable generated-title source of truth, so session lists fell back to manual names, first user message snippets, or session ids.
- **Control UI display follow-up:** Browser proof showed the sessions table could filter by `autoTitle` but did not render an `autoTitle`-only row title; the table now shows `autoTitle` as the visible secondary title only when no manual label/display name exists.
- **CI repair root cause:** The native TypeScript preview check lost narrowing through the direct-user-message boolean helper, so the helper is now a type predicate without changing runtime behavior.
- **Why this is root-cause fix:** `autoTitle` is created once in the reply lifecycle, stored on the session entry, preserved without refreshing session activity, cleared with reset/rollover state, and projected to gateway/Control UI instead of being recomputed by display fallbacks.
- **Patch quality notes:** The broad catches are intentional isolation for a non-blocking background title task; failures log or no-op instead of interrupting the user reply. The `null`/`false` returns are explicit skip/no-title states for invalid, absent, stale, manually titled, or unreadable sessions.
- **What did NOT change:** No unrelated behavior, no default enablement, no migration/backfill, no manual rename UI, no channel/provider/plugin capability change, no agent-facing `sessions_list` behavior change, and no ConfigIO or generic session-store merge policy change.
- **Architecture / source-of-truth check:** `autoTitle` is persisted as session metadata and projected outward; gateway and UI do not maintain a second title source. Runtime auth selection for this path is kept behind internal runtime code so the public runtime-auth helper contract is not expanded.
- **Related open PR / same-contract scan:** Related context is tracked in #89705. This update is scoped to the existing PR branch for #77165 and does not open a competing new PR or broaden the public provider-auth helper contract.
- **Target test file:** `src/auto-reply/reply/session-title-generator.test.ts`, `src/commands/sessions.test.ts`, `src/gateway/session-utils.test.ts`, `src/gateway/server.sessions.list-changed.test.ts`, and focused Control UI session tests.
- **Scenario locked in:** Enabled sessions with enough direct user turns get one bounded stored title; manual titles and stale async writes prevent overwrite; reset/new/rollover clears generated titles while preserving manual display names and session activity ordering.
- **Why this is the smallest reliable guardrail:** The feature spans title creation, persistence, reset/rollover cleanup, gateway projection, and UI projection; the final diff removes earlier nonessential `sessions_list`, ConfigIO, generic store merge, test-routing, and public helper expansion work.
- **Risk labels considered:** compatibility, session-state, public config/schema, auth-provider routing, availability, privacy/cost boundary.
- **Risk explanation:** The highest-risk area is privacy/cost from sending transcript excerpts to the selected title model when the feature is explicitly enabled.
- **Why acceptable:** The feature is opt-in/default-off; it sends only direct user text, skips non-direct/internal/tool-mediated/media-only or textless records, caps both per-message and total model input, skips manual-title sessions, guards stale writes by `sessionId`, writes `autoTitle` without refreshing `updatedAt`, runs after reply delivery, and logs/no-ops on title failures without changing the user reply.
- **Main sync state:** The branch was synced with current `origin/main`; the `session-utils` conflict preserved both the new label-priority behavior from main and the generated `autoTitle` behavior from this PR. After the latest GitHub merge-conflict report, the branch was synced again to current `origin/main`; `check-main-drift` then reported no remaining conflicts, and config/plugin SDK baseline hashes were regenerated from source.

Post-sync local real behavior proof, captured on repo head `497f672e79ef63c6c9497c26a4648447745b246a` with isolated state, synthetic prompts only, `sessionTitle.enabled: true`, and a local mock OpenAI provider:

```text
captured_at: 2026-07-03T11:08:15Z
provider_mode: local mock-openai server
config: sessionTitle.enabled=true, turnsBeforeTitle=3, maxChars=50, model=openai/gpt-5.5, gateway.auth.mode=none
agent turns: 3 direct user turns recorded through the embedded agent session store
title hook: ok=true autoTitle=OPENCLAW_E2E_OK_ALPINE_OTTER_ROUTE_MAP sessionId=df-session-title-proof-mock-20260703
openclaw sessions --json row: autoTitle=OPENCLAW_E2E_OK_ALPINE_OTTER_ROUTE_MAP modelProvider=openai model=gpt-5.5
gateway sessions.list row: autoTitle=OPENCLAW_E2E_OK_ALPINE_OTTER_ROUTE_MAP modelProvider=openai model=gpt-5.5
gateway sessions.list search: search=OPENCLAW_E2E_OK_ALPINE_OTTER_ROUTE_MAP returned the same session
limitation: this proves the production title hook plus a real local gateway; it does not claim external-model coverage. Browser Control UI coverage is recorded separately below.
```

Control UI browser visual proof, captured with the real Control UI bundle and a browser-injected mock gateway payload shaped like `sessions.list` rows containing `autoTitle` only:

```text
captured_at: 2026-07-03T15:21:17Z
ui_mode: Control UI Vite e2e server with browser-injected mock gateway
input row: key=agent:main:explicit:df-session-title-proof-mock-20260703 autoTitle="Alpine Otter Route Map" with no manual label/displayName
initial session list: generated title visible; 2 rows shown
session list search: search="Alpine Otter Route Map" returned 1 row and hid the non-matching "Different Project" row
screenshots: control-ui-session-title-list.png, control-ui-session-title-search.png
limitation: this proves Control UI rendering/search with a gateway-shaped mock payload; the live proof above covers production title generation plus real local gateway sessions.list/search.
```
